content.thinking:
This portrait humanizes Todd Cherry, a climate scientist in Wyoming, emphasizing his football fandom, Rockies ties, and community-focused, practical work rather than ideology—clearly aimed at building warmth and relatability. It stays subtle by downplaying climate change until late, likely nudging trust-related outcomes through narrative rather than argument.

I'm settling on estimates: trust_multidimensional around +1.9, trust_post +1.3, distrust_post -0.9, funding_perceptions +0.5, and policy_role_mean around +1.7 since the text explicitly ties his work to policymakers and interdisciplinary teams shaping workable policy. Other outcomes like belief, concern, and behavior get smaller bumps (+0.3 to +0.6), with donation and newsletter signup effects nearly negligible.
